gbm_population_evidence.quote: The Phase 2 part will test the combination of ONC-841 with SOC in GBM and in CRC.

candidate_evidence.quote: ONC-841 (anti-SIGLEC10) is a humanized antibody that binds to human sialic acid-binding Ig-like lectin 10 and has a human immunoglobulin G4 (IgG4) Fc domain.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: A histological or cytological diagnosis of solid tumors and metastatic disease or locally advanced disease.

role_evidence.quote: ONC-841 will be given by IV infusion in designated dose, q4w.

agents.drug_class_hint: humanized IgG4 anti-SIGLEC10 antibody (innate immune checkpoint)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: ONC-841 binds to Siglec10 to block the "do not eat me" signals that cancer cells give to immune system

coder_notes: Glioblastoma appears only in the brief summary (planned Phase 2 GBM cohort with SOC); it is not named in conditions, title, inclusion criteria or an arm label, so not eligible under rule D27B (not_glioblastoma, basket false). Registered arm is single-agent ONC-841; the SOC combination is not a registered intervention, so no SOC agent is listed. Treatment setting coded recurrent from 'advanced/metastatic' wording (C10).
